about: Upcoming launches and events for the Launch calendar. The daily recap adds, moves and removes entries. date is YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is known. status: event, confirmed, rumor, delayed or cancelled.

entries.title: Cyber Monday sales
entries.note: Black Friday brought almost no real GPU discounts; prebuilt PCs had the biggest cuts.

entries.title: GeForce RTX 50 Super series
entries.note: Reportedly shelved: no new GeForce gaming cards in 2026.

entries.title: Intel Arc Celestial gaming cards
entries.note: Reportedly cancelled; Battlemage stays on sale.

entries.title: CES 2027 (Las Vegas)
entries.note: The usual stage for new laptop chips and GPU announcements.

entries.title: AMD CES 2027 announcement
entries.note: Jack Huynh teased 'the next era of computing' for CES 2027; Zen 6 or RDNA 5 news is speculation.

entries.title: Intel Nova Lake (Core Ultra 400)
entries.note: Expected very late 2026 or at CES 2027.

entries.title: Intel next-gen desktop event (likely Nova Lake-S)
entries.note: VideoCardz reports Intel plans a desktop event for late February 2027.

entries.title: Nvidia GTC 2027
entries.note: Nvidia's yearly AI and architecture conference (usually March).

entries.title: Memory prices start to ease
entries.note: TrendForce (27 Nov): DRAM contract price rises slow through 2027 and level off in 2H27, with declines in 2028; in its weaker case, declines start in Q4 2027.

entries.title: AMD RDNA 5 Radeon GPUs
entries.note: Not expected before late 2027. Initial GFX13 (RDNA 5) driver support is queued for Linux 7.5 (early 2027).
